WITH actor_counts AS (
  SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count
  FROM actor a
  LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
  GROUP BY a.actor_id
), fractions AS (
  SELECT actor_id,
         film_count,
         film_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film) AS fraction_of_total
  FROM actor_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT actor_id,
         film_count,
         fraction_of_total,
         fraction_of_total - AVG(fraction_of_total) OVER () AS difference_from_average
  FROM fractions
)
SELECT actor_id, film_count, fraction_of_total, difference_from_average
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: “Fraction of the total” means the actor’s credited-film count divided by the total number of films in the film table; the average fraction is the unweighted mean of those fractions across all actors, including actors with no credits.
